name: 4: 42-day QP not reached; completion retains full earnings
description:
Creates a 2-year apprenticeship (730-day planned duration, qualifying period = 42 days), approves it, then records a completion after 30 days in learning. Although 30 < 42, completion always retains full earnings regardless of QP — the provider earns the full £6000.

Earnings are not subject to Qualifying Periods for Completion. Completion payment is still payable, along with a Balancing payment to roll-up the remaining earnings.

steps.name: SLD Records Completion (30 days in learning — below 42-day qualifying period)
